description: Follow a request for something only a person may do, such as entering a secret or signing in to a connector's provider, by the id a tool returned with its link: its state, when it expires, the link to give the person, who completed or declined it, what it set (names only, never values, and the connector a sign-in created), and what to do next. Pass wait_seconds 20 to wait up to 20 seconds for the person before answering. While the answer carries retry_after_seconds, call again with wait_seconds 20. Never ask the person to type a secret into this conversation. Requires connecting a Valet account.

id.description: Required. The request's id, from the tool that made it.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the request belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the request to change before answering. Default 0 answers at once. Use 20 while the answer carries retry_after_seconds.

name: get_request
title: Get a request
